description: Read-only. Can view doors, people, credentials and reports, and export them. Cannot enrol a fob, change access, pair a device or publish firmware. Intended as the baseline role for anyone who needs to answer 'who went where' without being able to change who gets in.

Day-to-day access administration: enrol and label fobs, assign them to people, deactivate a lost fob, add or remove people from existing groups, and issue device pairing codes. Cannot create or delete groups, change which groups a door honours, alter door config, or publish firmware -- the operations that redefine the access model rather than apply it.

Full control: everything an Operator can do, plus managing groups and door-to-group mappings, editing door configuration and schedules, publishing firmware, holding doors back from rollouts, and deleting people or credentials outright. Keep this membership small -- it is the role that can grant itself access to every door.
